title: Family and Medical Leave Act – FMLA (Luật Nghỉ phép Gia đình Y tế)

versions.text:
Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) – 29 USC §2601 et seq.
§2612: Leave requirement – 12 workweeks unpaid leave in 12-month period for: birth/adoption, serious health condition of employee or family member, qualifying exigency related to military service. §2614: Employment and benefits protection – restoration to same or equivalent position. §2615: Prohibited acts. §2617: Enforcement.
